summary: Gu Suizhou and Shen Feizhi navigate the aftermath of Lin Sui's death, which is ruled an accident despite their suspicions. Shen Feizhi learns through his contact, C2, that the death was orchestrated by someone using advanced technology from 'World Number 69' to bypass local security. It is revealed that someone has discovered the 'Main Star' and is communicating with it. Shen Feizhi, realizing the gravity of the situation and the potential danger to Gu Suizhou, decides to disclose the truth about spacetime planes, the Main Star, and his own nature to Gu Suizhou, who has been revealed to have made a 'compromise' with the World's Will.
